## Erlang code to Erlang-Red code

Generating nodes from the Erlang Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) notation.

## Resources

- https://www.erlang.org/doc/apps/erts/absform.html
- https://www.erlang.org/doc/apps/compiler/compile.html#noenv_forms/2
- https://www.erlang.org/doc/apps/stdlib/erl_anno.html
- https://www.erlang.org/doc/apps/stdlib/erl_pp.html
label: [.breadboard] generating AST trees

code:
-module(breadboard_ast_tree_to_flow).

-export([
    generate_flow_for_file/1,
    generate_flow_for_file/2
]).

epp_asbtree(Filename) ->
    {ok, Parsed} = epp:parse_file(Filename,
                                  [{macros,
                                    [{'HANDLE_COMMON', "", redefine},
                                     {'PUBLISH_DOCKSTATION_UNDOCK_EVENT', 'PUBLISH_DOCKSTATION_UNDOCK_EVENT'},
                                     {'MNESIA_TRANSACTION', 'MNESIA_TRANSACTION'},
                                     {'DEBUG', 'DEBUG'}, 
                                     {'WARNING', 'WARNING'},
                                     {'INFO', 'INFO'},
                                     {'ERROR', 'ERROR'},
                                     {'UNDEFINED', 'UNDEFINED'}]}]),
    Parsed.


%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%% Starting point for all this.
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%%
%%
generate_flow_for_file(FileName) when is_binary(FileName) ->
    generate_flow_for_file(binary_to_list(FileName));

generate_flow_for_file(FileName) when is_list(FileName) ->
    {ok, Content} = file:read_file(FileName),
    generate_flow_for_file(FileName, Content).

%%
%%
generate_flow_for_file(FileName, Content) when is_binary(FileName) ->
    generate_flow_for_file(binary_to_list(FileName), Content);

generate_flow_for_file(FileName, Content) when is_list(FileName) ->
    TopLevel = epp_asbtree(FileName),

    io:format("~p", [TopLevel]),

    ModuleName = module_name(TopLevel),

    ExportedFuncts = all_exports(TopLevel),
    
    AllNodes = lists:flatten([generate_flow(Thing) || Thing <- TopLevel]),

    %% hash-ify all link-in nodes by Name.
    LinkInNodes = maps:from_list(
        lists:flatten(
            lists:map(fun (#{<<"type">> := <<"link in">>, <<"id">> := Id, <<"name">> := Name}) -> [
                                        {Name, [Id]},
                                        {list_to_binary(io_lib:format("~p:~s",[ModuleName, binary_to_list(Name)])), [Id]}
                            ]; 
                            (_) -> {null,null} 
                    end, 
            AllNodes)
        )
    ),

    %% for all link out nodes, assign them a links array. THe links array
    %% contains the NodeIds of the corresponding link nodes. The link in node 
    %% needs no links array since the flow editor works it out automagically.
    AddLinksToLinkOut = fun
        (#{<<"type">> := <<"link out">>, <<"name">> := Name} = Nde) ->
            Nde#{ <<"links">> => maps:get(Name, LinkInNodes, []) };
        (#{<<"type">> := <<"link in">>, <<"name">> := Name} = Nde) ->
            case maps:find(Name, ExportedFuncts) of
                {ok, G} -> Nde#{ <<"g">> => G };
                _ -> Nde
            end;
        (Nde) -> 
            Nde
    end,
    AllNodesWithLinkouts = lists:map(AddLinksToLinkOut, AllNodes),

    %% Each function that is exported is assigned a group to clearly indicate
    %% which functions are exported and which function are internal to the module.
    Groups = [#{
        <<"id">> => GrpId,
        <<"type">> => <<"group">>,
        <<"name">> => FunName,
        <<"style">> => #{
            <<"label">> => true,
            <<"fill">> => <<"#e3f3d3">>
        },
        <<"nodes">> => lists:flatten( 
                            lists:map( 
                                fun(#{<<"g">> := GrpId2, 
                                    <<"id">> := NdeId}) when GrpId =:= GrpId2 -> [NdeId];
                                    (_) -> []
                                end, 
                                AllNodesWithLinkouts)
                            )
    } || {FunName, GrpId} <- maps:to_list(ExportedFuncts)],

    TabId = ered_nodes:generate_id(),

    Tab = #{
        <<"id">> => TabId,
        <<"type">> => <<"tab">>,
        <<"label">> => ModuleName,
        <<"info">> => list_to_binary(
                         io_lib:format("File: ~s~n~n```erlang~n~s~n```~n", [
                                re:replace(FileName, "^/tmp",""),
                                binary_to_list(Content)
                            ]
                         )
                      ),
        <<"disabled">> => false,
        <<"env">> => []
    },
    
    %% 'z' is the tab id because each node has 'x' 'y' as the location within the workspace
    %%     and 'z' represents the third dimension of tab.
    %% 'l' is the minified flag --> false means don't be long, i.e., short, i.e., hide the name.
    [Tab] ++ lists:map( 
            fun(Nde) -> Nde#{ <<"z">> => TabId, <<"l">> => false } end, 
            AllNodesWithLinkouts ++ Groups
     ).
    
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%% Generate Top Level flow handling
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

%%
%%
generate_flow(Thing) ->
    Nodes = generate_flow(Thing, []),

    %% one link in node for all functions that are overloaded, i.e., if the function name + arity
    %% match, then it is connected to the single link_in node.
    case Nodes of 
         [#{<<"id">> := FirstNodeId, name_arity := Name}|_] ->  

            Wires = lists:map( 
                fun(#{<<"id">> := Id, name_arity := Name2}) when Name2 =:= Name -> Id;
                    (_) -> <<>> 
                end, 
                Nodes
            ),

            Nodes ++ [#{
                <<"id">> => ered_nodes:generate_id(),
                <<"type">> => <<"link in">>,
                <<"name">> => Name,
                <<"links">> => [],
                <<"wires">> => [[Wire || Wire <- Wires, Wire =/= <<>>]]
            }];
        _ ->
            Nodes
    end.

%%%%%
%%      Top level node handling, in a module, these are functions and attributes.
%%%%%
generate_flow([], StackOfNodes) ->
    StackOfNodes;

generate_flow({function, _Anno, _Name, _Arity, []}, StackOfNodes) ->
    StackOfNodes;
    
generate_flow({function, _Anno, Name, Arity, [{clause, Anno, Conds, Guard, Repl}]} = FuncStmt, StackOfNodes) ->
    MyNode = #{
        <<"id">> => ered_nodes:generate_id(),
        <<"type">> => <<"function">>,
        <<"func">> => list_to_binary(erl_pp:function(FuncStmt)),
        <<"outputs">> => 1,
        <<"timeout">> => 0,
        <<"noerr">> => 0,
        <<"initialize">> => <<"">>,
        <<"finalize">> => <<"">>,
        <<"libs">> => [],
        <<"name">> => ered_nodes:jstr("[~p] ~p(~s) ~s", [
            erl_anno:line(Anno),
            Name,
            erl_pp:exprs(Conds),
            erl_pp:guard(Guard)
        ]),
        name_arity =>  list_to_binary(io_lib:format("~p/~p",[Name, Arity]))
    },

    {SubNodes, Wires} = case Repl of
        _ when is_list(Repl) ->
            A = [generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), [R], []) || R <- Repl],
            {A, [add_wire(C) || C <- A]};
        _ ->
            A = generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), Repl, []),
            {A, add_wire(A)}
    end,
    
    %% here we add one to the NodeId for any link out node added for a case statement.
    %% Node-RED will automagically remove any Ids that don't exist, so extra NodeIds that 
    %% don't exist are not an issue.
    NodeDef = MyNode#{<<"wires">> => 
        [lists:flatten([ [W, add_one_to_node_id(W)] || W <- lists:flatten(Wires)])]
    },
    
    [NodeDef] ++ SubNodes ++ StackOfNodes;

generate_flow(
    {function, Anno, Name, Arity, [Head | Rest]} = All, 
    StackOfNodes
) ->
    generate_flow(
        {function, Anno, Name, Arity, [Head]},
        generate_flow({function, Anno, Name, Arity, Rest}, StackOfNodes)
    );

generate_flow({attribute, _Anno, _Type, _Value}, StackOfNodes) ->
    %% ignored for now.
    StackOfNodes;

generate_flow({error, {_Anno, epp, _Value}}, StackOfNodes) ->
    %% ignored for now.
    StackOfNodes;

generate_flow(Ign, StackOfNodes) ->
    %% io:format("Ig: ~p~n", [Ign]),
    StackOfNodes.
    
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%% Generate Nodes
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

%%
%%
generate_nodes(
  _NodeId, [], StackOfNodes
) ->
    StackOfNodes;

generate_nodes(
    NodeId, [{'clause', _Anno, _Cond, _Guards, Repl} = ClauseStmt| Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    {
      SubNodes, 
      Wires, 
      Calls
    } = case Repl of
        _ when is_list(Repl) ->
            Calls = [extract_calls(R) || R <- Repl],
            A = [generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), [R], []) || R <- Repl],
            {A, [add_wire(C) || C <- A], Calls};
        _ ->
            Calls = extract_calls(Repl),
            A = generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), Repl, []),
            {A, add_wire(A), [Calls]}
    end,
    
    %% convert any function calls to link out nodes. These are then connected
    %% in a final step when we know all the functions defined in this
    %% code.
    LinkOutNodes = [
        #{
            <<"id">> => ered_nodes:generate_id(),
            <<"type">> => <<"link out">>,
            <<"name">> => C,
            <<"mode">> => <<"link">>,
            <<"links">> => [],
            <<"wires">> => []
        } || [C] <- Calls, [C] =/= [<<>>]
    ],
    
    %% Generate the name using the case_conditions
    [#{<<"v">> := Clause}] = case_conditions([ClauseStmt], []),
    
    MyCase = #{
        <<"id">> => NodeId,
        <<"type">> => <<"function">>,
        <<"func">> => list_to_binary(erl_pp:exprs(Repl)),
        <<"outputs">> => 1,
        <<"timeout">> => 0,
        <<"noerr">> => 0,
        <<"initialize">> => <<"">>,
        <<"finalize">> => <<"">>,
        <<"libs">> => [],
        <<"name">> => Clause,
        <<"wires">> => [
            Wires ++ 
            [add_one_to_node_id(Id) || Id <- Wires] ++ 
            [Id || #{<<"id">> := Id} <- LinkOutNodes] ++ 
            [add_one_to_node_id(Id) || #{<<"id">> := Id} <- LinkOutNodes]
        ]
    },
    
    generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), Rest, [MyCase] ++ StackOfNodes ++ SubNodes ++ LinkOutNodes);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'match', _Anno, _Lhs, {'call', _Anno, _Name, _Parameters} = CallStmt} | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    generate_nodes(NodeId, [CallStmt | Rest], StackOfNodes);
    
generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'match', _Anno, _Lhs, {'case', _Anno2, _Cond, _Clauses} = CaseStmt} | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    generate_nodes(NodeId, [CaseStmt | Rest], StackOfNodes);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'match', _Anno, _Lhs, {'if', _Anno2, _Repls} = IfStmt} | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    generate_nodes(NodeId, [IfStmt | Rest], StackOfNodes);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'case', Anno, Cond, Clauses} = CaseStmt| Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    BodyOfStuff = [generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), [Clause], []) || Clause <- Clauses],

    Conditions = case_conditions(Clauses, []),

    LinkOutNodeForCond = link_out_for_cond(add_one_to_node_id(NodeId), Cond),

    MyCase = #{
        <<"id">> => NodeId,
        <<"type">> => <<"switch">>,
        <<"property">> => <<"payload">>,
        <<"info">> => list_to_binary(erl_pp:expr(CaseStmt)),
        <<"propertyType">> => <<"msg">>,
        <<"checkall">> => <<"false">>,
        <<"repair">> => false,
        <<"outputs">> => length(Conditions),
        <<"name">> => ered_nodes:jstr("[~p] Case ~s of", [
            erl_anno:line(Anno),
            handle_cond(Cond)
        ]),
        <<"rules">> => Conditions,
        <<"wires">> =>
            lists:map(fun([#{<<"id">> := Id}|_]) -> [Id, add_one_to_node_id(Id)] end, BodyOfStuff)
    },
    
    generate_nodes(
        ered_nodes:generate_id(), 
        Rest, 
        [MyCase] ++ StackOfNodes ++ lists:flatten(BodyOfStuff) ++ LinkOutNodeForCond
    );

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'if', Anno, Repls} = IfStmt| Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    BodyOfStuff = [generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), [Repl], []) || Repl <- Repls],

    Conditions = if_guards(Repls, []),

    MyCase = #{
               <<"id">> => NodeId,
               <<"icon">> => <<"font-awesome/fa-question">>,
               <<"type">> => <<"switch">>,
               <<"property">> => <<"payload">>,
               <<"info">> => list_to_binary(erl_pp:expr(IfStmt)),
               <<"propertyType">> => <<"msg">>,
               <<"checkall">> => <<"false">>,
               <<"repair">> => false,
               <<"outputs">> => length(Conditions),
               <<"name">> => ered_nodes:jstr("[~p] If", [
                   erl_anno:line(Anno)
               ]),
               <<"rules">> => Conditions,
               <<"wires">> =>
                   lists:map(fun([#{<<"id">> := Id}|_]) -> [Id] end, BodyOfStuff)
    },
    generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), Rest, [MyCase] ++ StackOfNodes ++ lists:flatten(BodyOfStuff));

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{'try', Anno, TryBlock, [], CatchBlock, []} = TryStmt | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    TryNode = generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), TryBlock, []),
    CatchNode = generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), CatchBlock, []),

    NodeDef = #{
               <<"id">> => NodeId,
               <<"icon">> => <<"font-awesome/fa-umbrella">>,
               <<"type">> => <<"switch">>,
               <<"property">> => <<"payload">>,
               <<"info">> => list_to_binary(erl_pp:expr(TryStmt)),
               <<"propertyType">> => <<"msg">>,
               <<"checkall">> => <<"false">>,
               <<"repair">> => false,
               <<"outputs">> => 2,
               <<"name">> => ered_nodes:jstr("[~p] Try", [
                   erl_anno:line(Anno)
               ]),
               <<"rules">> => [#{
                        <<"t">> => <<"eq">>,
                        <<"v">> => <<"try">>,
                        <<"vt">> => <<"str">>
                    },
                   #{
                        <<"t">> => <<"eq">>,
                        <<"v">> => <<"catch">>,
                        <<"vt">> => <<"str">>
               }],
               <<"wires">> =>
                   lists:map(fun([#{<<"id">> := Id}|_]) -> [Id] ;
                                (_) -> []
                            end, [TryNode, CatchNode])
    },

    generate_nodes(ered_nodes:generate_id(), Rest, [NodeDef] ++ StackOfNodes ++ TryNode ++ CatchNode);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [{call, _Anno, _Name, _Parameters} = CallStmt | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    [Name] = extract_calls(CallStmt),

    NodeDef = #{
        <<"id">> => NodeId,
        <<"type">> => <<"link out">>,
        <<"name">> => Name,
        <<"mode">> => <<"link">>,
        <<"links">> => [],
        <<"wires">> => []
    },

    generate_nodes(add_one_to_node_id(NodeId), Rest, [NodeDef] ++ StackOfNodes);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, [Ign | Rest], StackOfNodes
) ->
    %% io:format("ignHd ~p",[Ign]),
    generate_nodes(NodeId, Rest, StackOfNodes);

generate_nodes(
  NodeId, Ign, StackOfNodes
) ->
    %% io:format("ign ~p",[Ign]),
    generate_nodes(NodeId, [], StackOfNodes).

%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%% Helpers
%% --------------------------------------------------------------------------------
%%
%%
if_guards([], Conds) ->
    Conds;
if_guards([{clause, Anno, [], Guards, _} | Rest], Conds) ->
    MyCond = #{
      <<"t">> => <<"eq">>,
      <<"v">> => list_to_binary(io_lib:format("[~p] ~s", [
                  erl_anno:line(Anno),
                  erl_pp:guard(Guards)
       ])),
       <<"vt">> => <<"str">>
    },
    if_guards(Rest, Conds ++ [MyCond]);
if_guards([Ign | Rest], Conds) ->
    %%io:format("IFIgn: ~p", [Ign]),
    if_guards(Rest, Conds).

%%
%%
to_name(Name,Parameters) -> 
    list_to_binary(
        io_lib:format("~s/~b", [
            erl_pp:expr(Name),
            length(Parameters)
        ])
    ).

%%
%%
extract_calls([]) ->
    [<<>>];
extract_calls([{call, Anno, Name, Parameters} | Rest]) ->
    [to_name(Name,Parameters)] ++ extract_calls(Rest);
extract_calls({call, Anno, Name, Parameters}) ->
    [to_name(Name,Parameters)];
extract_calls(_) ->
    [<<>>].

%%
%%
case_conditions([], Conds) ->
    Conds;
case_conditions([{clause, Anno, Cond, [], _} | Rest], Conds) ->
    MyCond = #{
      <<"t">> => <<"eq">>,
      <<"v">> => list_to_binary(io_lib:format("[~p] ~s", [
                  erl_anno:line(Anno),
                  handle_cond(Cond)
       ])),
       <<"vt">> => <<"str">>
    },
    case_conditions(Rest, Conds ++ [MyCond]);
case_conditions([{clause, Anno, Cond, Guard, _} | Rest], Conds) ->
    MyCond = #{
      <<"t">> => <<"eq">>,
      <<"v">> => list_to_binary(io_lib:format("[~p] ~s ~s", [
                               erl_anno:line(Anno),
                              handle_cond(Cond),
                           erl_pp:guard(Guard)
       ])),
       <<"vt">> => <<"str">>
    },
    case_conditions(Rest, Conds ++ [MyCond]);
case_conditions([Ign | Rest], Conds) ->
    io:format("CaseIgn: ~p", [Ign]),
    case_conditions(Rest, Conds).

%%
%%
handle_cond(Cond) when is_tuple(Cond) ->
    replace_all_newlines(erl_pp:expr(Cond));
handle_cond(Cond) ->
    replace_all_newlines(erl_pp:exprs(Cond)).

replace_all_newlines(Str) ->
    string:replace(Str, "\n", " ", all).
%%
%%
add_wire([]) ->
    [];
add_wire([#{<<"id">> := Id}|_]) ->
    [Id].

%%
%%
module_name(TopLevel) ->
    module_name(TopLevel, []).

%%
%%
module_name([], []) ->
    "";
module_name([], [Name|_]) ->
    Name;
module_name([{attribute, _Anno, module, Value}|Rest], Names) ->
    module_name(Rest, Names ++ [Value]);
module_name([_Hd|Rest], Names) ->
    module_name(Rest, Names).

%%
%%
all_exports(TopLevel) ->
    maps:from_list(
        lists:map( 
            fun( {Name,Arity} ) -> {
                list_to_binary(io_lib:format("~s/~b", [Name, Arity])),
                ered_nodes:generate_id()
            } 
            end,
            lists:flatten(all_exports(TopLevel, []))
        )
    ).

%%
%%
all_exports([], Exports) ->
    Exports;
all_exports([{attribute, _Anno, export, Value}|Rest], Exports) ->
    all_exports(Rest, Exports ++ Value);
all_exports([_Hd|Rest], Exports) ->
    all_exports(Rest, Exports).

%%
%%
add_one_to_node_id([NodeId]) ->
    add_one_to_node_id(NodeId);
add_one_to_node_id(<<>>) ->
    <<>>;
add_one_to_node_id(NodeId) when is_binary(NodeId) ->
    list_to_binary(
        string:lowercase(
            string:pad(
                integer_to_list(binary_to_integer(NodeId,16) + 1, 16),
                16,
                leading,
                "0"
            )
        )
    );
add_one_to_node_id(_) ->
    <<>>.

%%
%%
link_out_for_cond(NodeId, {call, _Anno, _Name, _Parameters} = CallStmt) ->
    [Name] = extract_calls(CallStmt),
    [#{
        <<"id">> =>  NodeId,
        <<"type">> => <<"link out">>,
        <<"name">> => Name,
        <<"mode">> => <<"link">>,
        <<"links">> => [],
        <<"wires">> => []
    }];
link_out_for_cond(_, _) ->
    [].
